festivals.name: Ugadi Mela
festivals.description: The New Year fair. Stalls, music, and bevu-bella for everyone.
intro: Welcome to the Ugadi Mela! A new year for Viralpadi.
The Harvest Offering is open — hold your finest crop, flower or find and bring it to the stall.

festivals.name: Aadi Perukku
festivals.description: The river festival. The valley thanks the monsoon for filling the tank.
intro: Happy Aadi Perukku! The tank is full and the rivers are generous.
Offer something from the water or the fields to thank the monsoon.

festivals.name: Deepavali
festivals.description: The festival of lamps. The square glows all evening.
intro: Happy Deepavali! Every lamp in the square is lit tonight.
Make an offering for the new light — the best gifts win the sweetest prize.

festivals.name: Pongal
festivals.description: The harvest thanksgiving. Rice boils over in clay pots — Pongalo Pongal!
intro: Pongalo Pongal! The pot has boiled over — a sign of abundance.
Offer the best of your year's harvest and share in the sakkarai pongal.
